question: Can selecting a two-operation perturbation followed by exact refinement improve on affordable hand search?
start: affinity followed by up to 64 best-improvement single-flip rounds
candidates: all unordered distinct operation pairs, flip both eligible hosts, then exactly two best-improvement single-flip rounds; retain incumbent
graph_rank: descending shared lock count, same job, same assigned host, then operation indices; no objective labels
random_rank: fixed RNG 77 permutation of all pairs, no objective labels
selection: lowest calibration mean objective among controls with p95 <=2ms; freeze before fresh cases
oracle: best final refined outcome over every pair plus incumbent; unpriced perfect selector, never a deployable policy
gate: fresh oracle median gain >=5%, bootstrap lower bound >0, frozen hand control p95<=2ms
live_gate: all fresh frozen-control, local-incumbent and oracle plans in real HeROsim plus independent SimPy, all task completion times checked even if offline screen fails
scope: exploratory mechanism screen, not GNN evidence; no training unless sufficient headroom and an equal-information representation challenge are demonstrated
